issue_context.title: MQTT Fan: "speed_range_max=3" gives invalid output of 0-> 0->1->3
issue_context.body:
### The problem

speed_range_max has been added recently. I tried to use "speed_range_max=3", only the MQTT output is wrong when using the slider.

When I use the slider I get 4 options:
0% -> translates to "0" in MQTT output
33% -> translates to "0" in MQTT output
67% -> translates to "1" in MQTT output
100% -> translates to "3" in MQTT output

I would have expected 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3 in the MQTT output.

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2021.4.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

MQTT Fan

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/fan.mqtt/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
fan:
  - platform: mqtt
    command_topic: "itho/fan1/cmd"
    percentage_command_topic: "itho/fan1/cmd"
    name: itho_fan
    speed_range_min: 1
    speed_range_max: 3
    retain: false
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>
Sane here,i didn't understand how to set 3 levels of the fan

0=off , is not a speed and should not be included in the speed range, so speed_range_min - 1 will be the output for 0 % see mqtt fan docs. https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/fan.mqtt/#speed_range_min

The function percentage_to_ranged_value(self._speed_range, percentage) is called, as suggested here: https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/fan/, but it seems math.ceil() should have been added to this function.
I will need to do some testing. This seems this happens when a percentage step has a fraction in it.
I have been testing and it seems this is the problem. I will come up a PR to fix this.
